corrections.reason: The 2nd-orderplural verb ending -ሡ (ትትኃሠሡ, 'you inquire among yourselves') is clearly visible on the right leg of the glyph and required by the 2nd person masculine plural context.
The archaic Andemta form printed on the page is እርሱ በርሳችሁ (with the 2nd-order vowel mark on ሱ, matching the end of the previous page).
The printed glyph is ወ (በቅንወተ ወልድከ, 'by the nails/piercing of Your Son', paired with በስቅለ ወልድከ, 'by the crucifixion of Your Son'), which was misread as ዐ.
The glyph is 1st-order ለ (አለመናችሁትም, 'you have not asked/petitioned Him', translating Ge'ez ኢሰአልክምዎ), not 4th-order ላ (አላመናችሁትም, 'you did not believe').
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of John 16:25 and the printed text read ክሡተ ('openly/plainly', adverbial accusative of ክሡት), with 6th-order ክ and 2nd-order ሡ.
The printed character is 1st-order ተ in the Ge'ez perfective verb ተናገርከነ ('You have spoken to us', citing John 16:29), not 6th-order ት.
